baseline.title: Shady – Baseline
baseline.description: The default baseline forecast every string uses unless it overrides it. This is asked first, before any string is configured.

data.temperature_aware: Baseline already accounts for temperature effects

strings.title: Shady – Strings
strings.description: Pick every entity that is a PV string. Adding or removing an entity here is the only way a string is added or removed.

string_settings_hub.title: Shady – Configure a string
string_settings_hub.description: Pick a string to configure further, or Done to move on.

string_settings_edit.title: Shady – String settings
string_settings_edit.description: Settings for this one string. Every field is always shown; leave a field at its default to skip that correction for this string.

data.name: Name (optional)
data.baseline_override: Baseline override (optional; default uses the global baseline)

regression_tuning.title: Shady – Regression tuning
regression_tuning.description: Global settings for the shading-model regression. These apply to every configured string.

advanced_optional.title: Shady – Advanced & optional settings
advanced_optional.description: Temperature-derating and intraday-correction settings. Global, applying to every configured string unless a string overrides its temperature source.

reconfigure.title: Shady – Reconfigure
reconfigure.description: Pick a section to change, or Save & Finish to apply your changes.
